title: Opening Cross receipt attestation, as the API serves it
description: The answer of GET /v1/crosses/{address}/receipt-attestation (ADR-0941): the newest signed attestation of a cross's receipt and the chain anchor that covers it, or null for either when it does not exist yet. With ?optional=1 an unattested cross answers 200 with `attestation: null`.

recordedAt.description: When the promiser stored the attestation, unix seconds. Only the anchor's block time bounds when it existed.

attestations.description: How many attestations the cross has; more than one means the served receipt changed after it had been attested, and every earlier one is kept.

signerIsPublished.description: Whether `attestation.signer` is the published signer; null when the API publishes none.

oneOf.description: The attestation has not been written to the chain yet; anchors are written every few minutes.

root.description: Merkle root over the ids of the attestations in this anchor (leaf prefix 0x00, node prefix 0x01, odd node promoted).

signature.description: The Memo transaction that wrote the root.

blockTime.description: Unix seconds of the block: the attestation existed no later than this.

memo.description: The text the transaction must carry.
